How To Add It To Outlook

  1. Enter your details above and select Copy signature.
  2. In Outlook, go to File → Account Info → Signatures → Add Signature.
  3. Enter a signature name, such as GEMS Signature.
  4. Click the editing space below the signature name. Press Enter three times to add space, then press Ctrl + V to paste your copied signature.
  5. Select Set default for new messages and Set default for replies and forwards if you want the signature added automatically.
  6. Select Save, then send yourself a test email.
